description: This map illustrates the geographic distribution of Production Units (DU) across Europe and provides a magnified example of a Natura 2000 (N2K) site, specifically for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Protected Areas (PA) status product 2021. The main map shows Europe and surrounding seas (Atlantic Ocean, Norwegian Sea, Barents Sea, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, Mediterranean Sea) divided into numerous Production units (DU) represented by white polygons with black outlines. Visible Production Unit labels include DU0001, DU0003, DU0006, DU0007, DU0009, DU0011, DU0013, DU0014, DU0015, DU0016, DU0017, DU0018, DU0019, DU0022, DU0023, DU0024, DU0025, DU0026, DU0027, DU0028, DU0031, DU0032, DU0033, DU0034, DU0035, DU0037, DU0038, and DU0039. A magnified inset, originating from the region of DU0013, details a selected Natura 2000 site. In this inset, the "Natura 2000 site extent" is shown in pink, while the "Buffered N2K AoI" (Area of Interest) is depicted in green, encompassing the pink area. A North arrow is present in the top-left corner. A scale bar indicates distances from 0 to 1,500 km, with intermediate marks at 500 km and 1,000 km.
